usageNotes: Performs a hard stop (equivalent to pulling the power cord) on a QEMU VM running on a remote PVE node managed by PDM — all unsaved in-guest state is lost immediately. The caller must hold `Resource.Manage` on the remote/guest ACL path. Returns a remote UPID string; poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion before assuming the VM is fully stopped.

examples.summary: Hard-stop VM 105 on remote 'pve-hetzner', letting PDM pick the node

destructiveReason: Immediately cuts power to the VM without a graceful shutdown, discarding any unsaved in-guest data and risking filesystem corruption.
tips: Prefer the shutdown endpoint when the guest OS is responsive — stop is a last resort for hung or unresponsive VMs.
The returned UPID is scoped to the remote PVE cluster; use the corresponding remote task-status endpoint (not a local PVE endpoint) to poll it.
If `node` is omitted, PDM resolves the current host node automatically — supply it explicitly if the VM might be in the middle of a migration.
